keyPoints.en: Skim for the main idea; scan for specific facts.
keyPoints.bm: Baca luncuran untuk idea utama; imbasan untuk fakta khusus.

keyPoints.en: The topic sentence (often first) holds a paragraph's main idea.
keyPoints.bm: Ayat topik (selalunya pertama) mengandungi idea utama perenggan.

keyPoints.en: Tersurat answers: find them in the text.
Tersirat answers: reason from clues (feelings, causes, implications).
keyPoints.bm: Jawapan tersirat: taakul daripada petunjuk (perasaan, sebab, implikasi).

keyPoints.en: Answer in complete sentences that echo the question.
keyPoints.bm: Jawab dengan ayat lengkap yang mengulang fokus soalan.

keyPoints.en: Underline the focus word in the question.
Pick only matching points; paraphrase them.
keyPoints.bm: Pilih isi yang sepadan sahaja; olah isi.

keyPoints.en: Opening + points with connectors + closing; stay within the limit.
keyPoints.bm: Pendahuluan + isi dengan penanda wacana + penutup; patuhi had perkataan.

tip.en: Number your points in pencil while reading — then you know how many you have.
tip.bm: Nomborkan isi dengan pensel semasa membaca — anda akan tahu bilangan isi yang ada.
